childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_image_alt: Umzali ophethe usana olusanda kuzalwa futhi elubuka
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Lapho izingane zizalwa ukubona kwazo kuba buthakathaka. Ngokuyisisekelo ziba njengezi 'yimpumputhe'. Nokho ukubona kwazo kukhula eminyakeni emi-5 kuya kweyi-8 elandelayo, futhi intuthuko enkulu yenzeka ezinyangeni eziyi-18 zokuqala zokuphila. Lesi isikhathi esibaluleke kakhulu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: Ngalesi sikhathi uhlelo lokubona lwamehlo nobuchopho kufanele lube luphilile futhi luthole ukuvuselelwa. Lesi yisikhathi esihle kakhulu sokuhlonza isifo nokudlulisela ukuze kutholakale ukwelashwa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Kungani futhi kanjani sihlonza isifo ukuze sikhulise ukukhula kokubona kakhulu
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Noma yisiphi isifo seso noma sobuchopho sizobambezela ukukhula futhi sinciphise ukubona kwesikhathi eside. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuhlonza ngokushesha okukhulu noma yiziphi izimbangela zesifo ezingelashwa ezithinta ukukhula okujwayelekile kokubona kanye nokukhula komzimba jikelele.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: Lokhu kungenziwa ngokubuza imibuzo ngokubona, ukukhulelwa, ukuzalwa, noma yikuphi ukugula kanye nokukhula jikelele
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: Bese ubheka amehlo ukuhlola ukukhula kokubona, bese uhlola isifo samehlo ngokwenza ukuhlolwa kwe fundal 'red' reflex nangokuhlola ingxenye engaphambili yeso
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: Ngaphakathi esibelethweni, umntwana ongakazalwa uzungezwe umsindo opholile futhi opholile, kuhlanganise nokushaya kwenhliziyo kanina namazwi nomsindo ovela ngaphandle.
Njengoba ukukhulelwa kufinyelela esigabeni sokugcina, amehlo omntwana angavuleka ngaphakathi esibelethweni.
Yize bengakakwazi ukubona izithombe noma imininingwane, bangezwa izinguquko ekukhanyeni.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Umdwebo wesiteji sokukhulelwa wengane engakazalwa esibelethweni
Umfanekiso wesiteji sokukhulelwa sekwephuzile obonisa ukuqaphela ukukhanya
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: Ngesikhathi sokuzalwa, ukubona akufani kakhulu nokomuntu omdala. Ingane esanda kuzalwa 'iyimpumputhe' futhi ingaboni kahle kahle cishe ku-6/600. Abawuboni umbala omningi futhi banokuzwela okungafani okuphansi. Abanayo i-stereovision futhi amehlo abo angase ancinze njalo njalo.

Kodwa-ke bazobuka ngqo ubuso obuseduze kakhulu, bese becindezela amehlo abo ukuze bavale ukukhanya okukhanyayo. Umbono wabo kusukela manje uzokhula ngokushesha okukhulu futhi ube njengomuntu omdala ngeminyaka eyi-8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: Phakathi namasonto amabili umbono usuthuthuke kakhulu. Manje bangabona imininingwane ethile, ikakhulukazi uma izinto ziseduze. Awukho umbala futhi ezikubonayo kuyisicaba, ngoba amehlo azo awakakaqondile ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi asebenza ndawonye ukuze abone ukujula.
Ngezinye izikhathi amehlo abo azokhukhuleka noma aphume isikhashana. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuklolodela. Lokhu kufanele kuyeke ukwenzeka ngezinyanga ezintathu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: Ngenyanga eyodwa ukukhanya kombala kuyaqala ukukhula. Bazoba nesithakazelo kakhulu ngokubukeka ikakhulukazi ebusweni. Bazoqala nokuzama ukulandela izinto ezihambayo.
Bazokwazi ngokwengeziwe imisindo ejwayelekile kuhlanganise namazwi aziwayo njengomndeni wabo. Futhi baqale ukuhlanganisa abakuzwayo nabakubonayo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalayo phakathi kwamasonto amabili nenyanga eyodwa
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: Ngezinyanga ezintathu amehlo azo kufanele ahlale eqondile futhi asebenze ndawonye ukuze enze umbono we-3D. Lo mbono omusha ojulile ubasiza ukuba bafinyelele izinto ngokunembe kakhudlwana. Bazokwazi ukulandela izinto ezihamba ngokushesha kodwa kunzima ukushintsha ukulungiswa kusuka ebusweni obunye noma into iye kwenye ngokushesha.
Bathanda ukubuka into eyodwa kuphela ngesikhathi. Bangase futhi baqale ukwenza imisindo yabo yokuqala ezwakalayo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalayo phakathi kwenyanga eyodwa nezintathu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Usana olubonayo ngokujwayelekile luzojabula lapho lubona inkomishi yokuphuza noma isipuni futhi lungalungisa futhi lulandele ubuso bubangeni elingamamitha angu-1-2 futhi lukwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kobuso obujwayelekile nobungajwayelekile ngabo bobabili ubuso nangamazwi.
Bangaqala nokubona izinto ezikude. Beqhutshwa ilukuluku, bazoqala ukufinyelela izinto.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: Ezinyangeni eziyisi-6 kuye kweziyi-12 ubudala ikhono lokubona liyathuthuka futhi licishe libe ngu-6/36. Ibanga okubukwa ngalo ubuso nokwabonwa linwetshiwe libe ngamamitha angu-2. Zonke izici zokubona ziyathuthuka ngokufinyelela nokubamba okunembe kakhudlwana.

Kule minyaka sebethanda kakhulu izithombe ezisezincwadini nakumabonakude, nakuba izinto zangempela zibakhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi bagaqe futhi ngesikhathi sosuku lwabo lokuzalwa lokuqala, bahambe bebheke ezintweni abazithandayo. Ukubhuqa kwabo kuyakhula, futhi imisindo izoba amagama okuqala nakule minyaka.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: Ezinyangeni eziyi-18, ukubona sekukhulile impela njengoba kusafiphele kancane ekuhlakanipheni kokubukwa cishe ngo-6/18. Manje bazokwazi ukubona igama labo futhi basebenzise amagama amaningi.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalayo phakathi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili neziyishumi nesishiyagalombili
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Ngemva kwezinyanga ezingu-18 ubudala, ukubona kusadinga iminyaka eminingana ukuvuthwa. I-acuity evamile yabantu abadala izokwakhiwa lapho eneminyaka engu-8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalayo phakathi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili neminyaka eyisishiyagalombili
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Ngemva kweminyaka engu-8 isistimu yokubuka ingase ingathuthuki kahle ekwelapheni njengokuhlinzwa kwe-cataract. Ngakho-ke ukuhlonzwa kwezifo nokudluliselwa kokwelashwa kwenziwa kangcono kusenesikhathi empilweni.

Kuyabonakala ukuthi ukukhula okukhulu kwenzeka phakathi kokuzalwa nezinyanga eziyi-18 ubudala futhi kuqhubeka kancane kancane kuyo yonke iminyaka yobuntwana. Ngalesi sikhathi kubalulekile ukuthi ingane ibe nempilo enhle futhi ingakwazi ukubona izifo futhi ihlinzekwe ngendawo evuselelayo neyondlayo ngokwemfundo.
Ukuhlonzwa kusenesikhathi kwesifo ngokudluliselwa kokwelashwa kubalulekile ukusiza ukukhulisa kokubili ukukhula okubonakalayo nokujwayelekile.

Uma udala i-akhawunti, sicela ugcine imininingwane yakho yokungena ivikelekile.
Ubophezelekile ngomsebenzi ku-akhawunti yakho ngaphandle kokuthi usazise mayelana nokusetshenziswa kabi noma inkinga yezokuphepha.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_education_only: Lolu hlelo lokusebenza ithuluzi lezemfundo ukusekela ukufunda nokubuyekeza. Akusona iseluleko esisemthethweni, sezomthetho noma sochwepheshe futhi asikwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuphasa, amamaki nanoma yimuphi umphumela othile. Izinketho zocwaningo nezinqumo zihlala ziyisibopho somsebenzisi.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_how_we_use_data:
Le datha isiza ukuhlanganisa uhlelo lokusebenza nezinjongo zomuntu ngamunye, ukuqonda ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lusetshenziswa kanjani nokuthuthukisa izici ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ingase futhi isetshenziselwe ukuxhumana mayelana nezinguquko ezibalulekile kuhlelo lokusebenza noma ku-akhawunti.
Idatha yomuntu siqu ayithengiswa neze.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_identity_check: Umazisi ungase udinge ukuqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokuba isicelo siqedwe. Uma noma yiluphi ulwazi kufanele lugcinwe ngezizathu zomthetho noma zokuphepha, lokhu kuzochazwa.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_minimum_data: Ulwazi oludingekayo kuphela ukuze kuqalise futhi kuthuthukiswe isevisi oluqoqwayo.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_service_limits: Inhloso ukugcina uhlelo lokusebenza luwusizo futhi luthembekile, kodwa ayikho isevisi engenaphutha. Ukutholakala okuqhubekayo noma ukukhululeka okuphelele emaphutheni akukwazi ukuthenjiswa, futhi uhlelo lokusebenza kungenzeka lungahambisani nazo zonke izimo.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_storage: Ulwazi lugcinwa kuseva ephethwe kanye nesizindalwazi esihlinzekwe ngabakwaRailway. Isitimela sihlinzeka ngokubamba kanye nengqalasizinda; silawula ukuthi idatha isetshenziswa kanjani ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza futhi siyigcine kuphela isikhathi eside esidingeka ngokuphusile.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_third_party: Sithembele kumasevisi athenjwayo ezinkampani zangaphandle, njengabahlinzeki bokusingatha, ukusebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza. Lawa masevisi acubungula kuphela idatha njengoba kudingeka ukuze kuhlinzekwe ingqalasizinda futhi ayinayo imvume yokuyisebenzisela izinjongo zawo.
i18nExtra.onboarding_privacy_uk_law_limits: Ngokuvumelana nomthetho wase-UK, asinasibopho sokulahlekelwa okufana namamaki aphuthelwe, imali engenayo elahlekile noma amathuba avela ngokusebenzisa, noma ukungakwazi ukusebenzisa, uhlelo lokusebenza.
